description: Cross-device handoff (J08): the same project is inspected across devices; the authoritative state is resolved through the gateway; the world projection digest is identical on both devices.

steps.expectation: the mobile client receives the world snapshot with digest 52b9c01cd891b37ed96c8226ed0c969bd08c57ba6e0d0cdb9a0e2c656ff2e33f
the desktop client receives the SAME snapshot digest 52b9c01cd891b37ed96c8226ed0c969bd08c57ba6e0d0cdb9a0e2c656ff2e33f (authoritative state resolved through Epoch)
the session scope (principal + tenant) is identical across devices; no second semantic ledger
the local projection cache admits the server projection by digest (read-only, immutable)
